newsitem.title: USA: U.S. producer prices tumble in April.
newsitem.headline: U.S. producer prices tumble in April.

text.p: Producer prices posted their biggest decline in nearly four years in April, tumbling by 0.6 percent as food and energy costs declined, the Labor Department said on Wednesday.

This was the fourth straight month that producer prices have fallen and followed a 0.1 percent decline in March. Excluding volatile food and energy costs, producer prices fell by 0.1 percent in April, after a 0.4 percent rise in March.
